summary: Capture checkout-start events and gateway failure reason codes in the payment lifecycle

ai.s: Records a "checkout started" event and gateway failure reason codes in the payment lifecycle, so funnel abandonment and failure causes can be analysed later.
ai.pr: Only completed orders existed and failures were stored as a bare failed status, making checkout abandonment and failure-cause analysis impossible after the fact.
ai.wy: Raised while the Reg-OT payments refactor (EP-56046) builds the lifecycle model, to avoid a costly retrofit.
ai.oc: The payment record is to persist checkout-start events and gateway-provided error codes as part of the new lifecycle.

summary: Exhibitor side repeatable entries and multi-file upload

ai.s: Exhibitors can add rows on demand to Exhibitor Manual table sections and upload several files to one File field.
ai.pr: Table row counts were fixed by the organiser and File fields took one file, so exhibitors with more entries emailed the organiser instead.
ai.wy: Raised by FESPA Middle East (about 500 exhibitors, REQ-2026-075); email workarounds defeat structured collection.
ai.oc: Exhibitors are to add and remove their own rows before submission and attach multiple files per File field, saved with their entries.

summary: Restrict meetings for exhibitors without team members (rework)

ai.s: Adds a mobile setting that blocks Meet and Message for exhibitors with no team members, with explanatory toasts for attendees and owners.
ai.pr: Attendees could try to meet or message exhibitors that had no team members to respond.
ai.wy: Rework of the restriction to one clear rule without changing existing GDPR or connection settings.
ai.oc: With the setting on, buttons are greyed with a 2-second toaster on all listed surfaces; child exhibitors' members do not count for the parent.

summary: [OT] Organizer Platform: Add engagement tracking to interactive elements in App Builder Custom Blocks

ai.s: Adds click and impression tracking to sponsor banners, story reels and experience cards in HYVE's App Builder custom blocks.
ai.pr: Interactive elements placed via custom HTML in App Builder captured no engagement data, so organisers could not prove sponsored placement value.
ai.wy: One-time fix for HYVE to report sponsor performance to exhibitors and sponsors.
ai.oc: Tracking and a report with date, timestamp, asset and user columns are being built for unique and total engagement.

summary: Resolve the visitor locale in middleware instead of after hydration

ai.s: Resolves a first-time visitor's locale in middleware from Accept-Language, instead of rendering one language and switching after hydration.
ai.pr: Locale was chosen client-side after render, and the server detector silently failed on non-BCP-47 locale codes such as es_lat and tha.
ai.wy: SEO and user experience: pages were served in one language and then navigated away in another.
ai.oc: Middleware is to detect the locale with a valid locale mapping so the first response is already in the right language.

summary: Session Calendar View - Toggle On/Off

ai.s: The mobile app shows or hides the Session Calendar View according to a backend feature flag.
ai.pr: The app had no way to enable or disable the Session Calendar View per configuration.
ai.wy: Organisers need control over whether the calendar view is offered.
ai.oc: The app is to read the flag, show the view when enabled, hide it when disabled and fall back safely if the flag is absent.

summary: bootstrap.php: report every unloadable DI class instead of aborting the registration loop

ai.s: Makes bootstrap.php report every DI provider class it cannot load, instead of silently skipping it or aborting on the first one.
ai.pr: An unresolvable DI class made class_implements() return false and was silently skipped, so the missing service only failed far away at first use.
ai.wy: Split out of PR #4828 at the reviewer's request; a bare throw was rejected as it changed failure behaviour for about 10 entrypoints.
ai.oc: The registration loop is to complete and report all unloadable classes together.

summary: Saved search queries: expose the list endpoint as GET instead of POST

ai.s: Exposes the saved search queries list endpoint as GET instead of POST, with the POST route deprecated.
ai.pr: /api/v1/search-suggestions/savedQueries was a pure read served over POST, uncacheable and looking like a write to intermediaries.
ai.wy: Follow-up from the EP-55950 review; it could not change there because the verb change breaks the shipped contract.
ai.oc: A GET route is to be added, the frontend switched, POST deprecated then removed, and OpenAPI and README updated.

summary: EditProfileWrapper sends undefined category_id on profile save

ai.s: Fixes the standalone Edit Profile page sending an undefined category_id on every profile save.
ai.pr: EditProfileWrapper read category_id from the Redux login user, which never has it, instead of the profileEdit response that does.
ai.wy: Same bug already fixed in MeetingProgramProfileStage; wrong data sent on every save.
ai.oc: category_id is to be sourced from data.userData, matching the MeetingProgramProfileStage fix.

summary: List the source values already arriving that the backend cannot map or display, and decide per value: document, rename, or stop tracking

ai.s: Lists every source value arriving in statistics that the backend cannot map or display, and decides for each whether to document, rename or stop tracking it.
ai.pr: Some urn_source and refer_source values were in neither SourcePagesEnum nor Sources v2, so reports showed them as raw strings or a dash.
ai.wy: Split out of EP-55681 to clean up source attribution in client reports.
ai.oc: An exhaustive list measured across 327 tenant databases exists; each value is to get a document, rename or stop decision.

summary: Empty source pair: split the 1.5M rows/90d of missing urn_source + refer_source into owners and decide what to collect

ai.s: Breaks down the 1.5M rows per 90 days with empty source columns into their owners and decides what each should collect.
ai.pr: Nearly half of traffic carried no refer_source and about a fifth neither source, which is what the user-facing "Unknown" bucket is made of.
ai.wy: The largest finding of the EP-55681 source analysis; five populations with four owners.
ai.oc: The data is held and split by population so each owner can fix collection; only one population is a defect on the team's side.

summary: Mobile apps send CamelCase screen names instead of contract source slugs in ws_time_online_statistics (new since 2026-07-16, growing)

ai.s: Makes the mobile apps send contract source slugs rather than CamelCase screen names in online-time statistics.
ai.pr: Since 16 July 2026 iOS and Android sent screen class names such as MenuPage and ExhibitorsList as the urn, 40 values and growing.
ai.wy: Mobile page and time-online reports group by urn, so these rows fall outside the reporting dictionary.
ai.oc: The apps are to emit the documented lower snake_case slugs for online-time tracking.

summary: ws_time_online_statistics: mobile apps still send pre-rename singular source names (delegate_list, exhibitor_list, session_list and 8 more) that are not in the contract

ai.s: Stops the mobile apps sending 11 pre-rename singular source names, such as delegate_list, in online-time statistics.
ai.pr: The same screens reported under both old singular names and contract names, splitting mobile report figures.
ai.wy: Source contract consistency for mobile reporting.
ai.oc: The residual old names are to be replaced with the contract names in the apps.

summary: ws_time_online_statistics: filter screens arrive as sources in both singular and plural form (_filter / _filters) — decide whether they belong in the contract at all

ai.s: Decides whether mobile filter screens belong in the source contract at all, as they arrive under both _filter and _filters spellings.
ai.pr: Eleven filter-screen values in two spellings were in neither SourcePagesEnum nor Sources v2.
ai.wy: Low volume but one decision covers a whole class of screens.
ai.oc: A decision is needed to add a single spelling to the contract or stop tracking filter screens as sources.
